text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the central plaza,
two Uma Musume talking with serious faces
caught my eye.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: An interview? For me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
You're often picked as the first or second
favorite
in your races, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
They'd like to hear the secret behind your
rock-solid popularity.
What do you think?
Would you agree to do it?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind giving an interview.
Though if you're asking for my secret...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In my view,
I am merely adept at playing it safe.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
By keeping as far away from danger as possible,
the risk is low,
and suffering defeat is rare.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My popularity simply came from the reassurance
of 'never losing,'
so there really isn't anything worth talking
about
in an interview...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm, I see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Are you feeling frustrated?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Being favored is proof of everyone's
expectations.
It's not something you can earn easily.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It is worth taking another look at why
you ended up carrying that burden in the
first place.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Worth considering, huh...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, found Hayahide!!
Heeyyy!! Haya-hiii-deee!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You were talking to the President earlier!
Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It seems I've received a request for an
interview.
Apparently,
they want to ask about the secret to my
popularity, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She confided in her two friends what she
had
just spoken about with Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Safety measures? That's that thing, right?
Like making sure it's not dangerous!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uuu, you're so amazing,
Hayahideee~! Thad's how you're
alwayz prodecting everyone,
aren't youuu~~...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Uh, that's a 'safety barrier'.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Also,
Hayahide is probably overthinking it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Popularity is just whatever mood people are
in at the time,
so there's no need to overthink it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What...? 
I'm... overthinking it...?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That's not it!!
It's definitely not that my head
got bigger from overthinking,
or anything...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I never said that, though?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You'll be fine! Hayahide,
you're amazing after all!
It's definitely gonna be a great
interview~!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I-Indeed... I hope that's the case.
